extracted.intended_audience: early-career biomedical researchers and prospective postdoctoral fellows seeking funding
extracted.subtask_description: Overview page for The Helen Hay Whitney Foundation (HHWF) fellowship program describing the foundation's mission, target audience, and values rather than detailed application rules. Useful for prospective postdoctoral applicants wanting general eligibility and mission-level selection priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: basic biomedical sciences
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting Postdoctoral Research Training in all of the basic biomedical sciences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the foundation's funding is focused on basic biomedical science research; prospective projects should fall within this domain. No further field-by-field eligibility details are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Target audience / career stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Since 1947, The Helen Hay Whitney Foundation Fellowship has been providing independent postdoctoral research support to young biomedical scientists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implies the fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers at the postdoctoral stage. The page does not provide explicit eligibility thresholds (e.g., years since PhD) but emphasizes 'young' postdoctoral scientists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection values: independent thinking, creativity, passion for scientific discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation recognizes and encourages independent thinking, creativity, and passion for scientific discovery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These mission-level values suggest evaluators favor applicants who demonstrate independence, creativity, and strong motivation; the page offers no scoring rubric or concrete examples of how these qualities are assessed.
